requirement: The retired docs host must not serve competing indexable documentation. Unreachable, 404, 410, or a direct 301/308 to the matching new /docs URL are acceptable. A direct redirect is preferred only when preserving old backlinks or indexed URL equity matters.
note: The old docs subdomain is retired. This repository owns the replacement /docs routes. Run npm run docs:migration-check when you want to verify that the retired host has not started serving duplicate content again.
